summary: The school district urges the Commission to keep the E-Rate program in place and decline to phase it out or sunset it The comment opposes limiting E-Rate to rural areas or areas with a single provider, as it would place the full cost of sustaining it onto local budgets and not belong to Congress. It also supports maintaining MIBS eligibility for small districts like District 75. The comment opposes phasing out E-Rate, emphasizing the cost implications and advocating for local educator involvement in technology decisions. It supports preserving the program and maintaining control over classroom technology by local school boards.
